headline: Recommended signs for Harborlight Homes and Turtle Woods; SalemFive / Dunkin’ Donuts sign motion failed.
summary: Six sign applications were reviewed. Five received a recommendation for approval, each by a 5-0 vote. The SalemFive / Dunkin’ Donuts sign at 19 West Street failed 0-5 after members raised concerns about its size and accessible space.
decisions: Recommended approval of wall signs for Harborlight Homes at 41 Pleasant Street, 5-0.
Recommended approval of signs for Turtle Woods / Turtle Creek at 401 Essex Street, 5-0.
Failed 0-5 on a motion to recommend approval of signage for SalemFive / Dunkin’ Donuts at 19 West Street.
Recommended approval of signage for Mobil/Dunkin’ at 44 Dodge Street, 5-0.
Recommended approval of signage for Concierge Primary Care at 181 Elliott Street, 900 Cummings Center, 5-0.
Recommended approval of signage for Rising Star Preschool at 323 Elliott Street, 5-0.
Approved the September 3, 2026, meeting minutes as amended, 5-0.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion to recommend approval of the signs for Harborlight Homes at 41 Pleasant Street, as discussed. Barone Jr. seconds. Motion carries (5-0).
Motion to recommend approval of the signs for Turtle Woods / Turtle Creek at 401 Essex Street... Clawson seconds. Motion carries (5-0).
Motion to recommend approval of the signage for SalemFive / Dunkin’ Donuts at 19 West Street, as presented. Flannery seconds. Motion fails (0-5).
Motion to recommend approval of the proposed signage for Mobil/Dunkin’ at 44 Dodge Street, as submitted... Flannery seconds. Motion carries (5-0).
Motion to recommend approval of the proposed signage for Concierge Primary Care at 181 Elliott Street, 900 Cummings Center, as submitted. Hutchings seconds. Motion carries (5-0).
Motion to recommend approval of the proposed signage for Rising Star Preschool at 323 Elliott Street... Barone Jr. seconds. Motion carries (5-0).
Motion to approve the September 3, 2026, meeting minutes, as amended. Flannery seconds. Motion carried (5-0).
